title: Split the order summary
summary: Break one long order-summary function into short, focused functions with narrow interfaces.
instructions: summarize_order(order) returns item_count, subtotal_cents, discount_cents, tax_cents and total_cents for an order.
An order has items (each with qty and unit_cents), an optional coupon and a country.
Coupons: SAVE10 takes 10% off the subtotal (rounded down); FLAT500 takes 500 cents off, at most the subtotal; anything else nothing.
Tax is applied after the discount, rounded down: DE 19%, FR 20%, every other country 0%.
The starter code is correct; restructure it into functions that each do one thing.
constraints: Every function is at most 15 lines long.
Every function takes at most 3 parameters.

acceptance_criteria.description: The examples produce the expected summaries.
